verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs claim it is 'typically among the first providers to deploy a newly released model' and that it runs 'the latest machine learning models', which speaks directly to the story. However, this rests on a single vendor assertion: there are no concrete release-to-availability timelines, no named examples, and no explicit focus on open-weight releases. Missing for 10: documented time-to-availability for new open-weight releases, specific model launch examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of day-one availability.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release

citations.quote: DeepInfra is typically among the first providers to deploy a newly released model.
DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud that makes it simple to run the latest machine learning models at scale
